initialExam.title: TSPSC Group 1 Services 2026
initialExam.description: TSPSC Group 1 exam for senior administrative posts in Telangana state government.
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: GS & Mental Ability. Mains: GS-I to III, Telangana Movement, Indian Economy, Telugu/Urdu. Interview.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 150Q, 150 marks. Mains: 6 papers, 900 marks. Interview: 75 marks.
initialExam.jobRole: Deputy Collector, DSP, Commercial Tax Officer, and Telangana state civil services
initialExam.careerGrowth: Deputy Collector → Joint Collector → District Collector → Secretary.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit tspsc.gov.in 2. Register (OTPR) 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Government accommodation, Vehicle, Medical, Pension
